_readme: OpenHistoricalMap countries laid over the Cliopatria base on the maps from 1800 to 1880, by map: [relation id, our name, options], largest first (where two overlap, the later one wins). Options: props (ruler s, note w) for the shape, partsIn (only the relation's parts whose middle lies in these lon/lat boxes), adopts (Cliopatria polities that are the same country: they take this name). Generated from OHM and checked against Cliopatria and HistoGIS; relations left out are listed in `left out` (every map) and `left out by map`.

left out.2696467: Holy Roman Empire: one shape over its member states, which would hide the Habsburg lands; Cliopatria draws the members
left out.2698260: Mozambique, 1752-1836: drawn at the borders agreed in 1891, while Portugal held the coast and the Zambezi valley; Cliopatria's outline is used
left out.2746685: Ottoman Empire: includes Egypt and Libya, which ran their own affairs; Cliopatria and HistoGIS draw it instead
left out.2831205: British Arctic Territories before 1880: a claim over Inuit land, not yet British
left out.2831207: North-West Territories before 1870: a later British territory drawn over Indigenous land
left out.2839982: Bateke Protectorate: drawn at the later extent of the French Congo
left out.2860736: Spanish Philippines: duplicates the Captaincy General of the Philippines
left out.2861459: Upper River (Haut-Fleuve): drawn at the later extent of French Sudan, not the posts France held
left out.2865803: Kingdom of Imerina, 1750-1885: one outline over all of Madagascar, while the kingdom grew from the central highlands; Cliopatria's outlines are used
left out.2918515: French Tourane: promised to France in 1787 but never handed over; a French concession only from 1888
left out.2923744: Mughal Empire in 1800: drawn at its nominal extent over most of India; the emperor held only the country around Delhi

1800.2801004: British Ceylon, 1796-1802: drawn over the whole island but a small hole at Kandy, while the Kingdom of Kandy held the hill country until 1815; Cliopatria's coast and kingdom are used
1800.2801147: Dutch East Indies, 1800-1810: drawn over all of today's Indonesia and western New Guinea, while the Dutch held Java and scattered posts and Britain held Ambon, Banda and Padang; Cliopatria's outline of the posts is used
1800.2847598: Awadh, 1722-1801: one outline for eighty years, which in 1800 runs over Benares (British from 1775), the upper Doab (Scindia's) and Bundelkhand; Cliopatria's outline for 1800 is used
1800.2948781: Sultanate of Tidore, 1797-1806: a gap in its border (two lines across south Halmahera); its outline from 1806 on (2948780), the same but for that line, is used

1815.2828775: Colony of Sierra Leone, 1808-1896: drawn at the borders of the 1896 protectorate, while the colony was the Freetown peninsula; Cliopatria's outline is used
1815.2848265: Dutch East Indies, 1815-1824: drawn over all of today's Indonesia, while Britain still held the Dutch posts (Java until August 1816, the Moluccas until 1817); Cliopatria's outlines of them are drawn as British
1815.2965452: Maratha Confederacy, 1788-1818: one outline, traced from a map of 1792, so it still holds Delhi, the Doab, Cuttack and Gujarat, taken by the British in 1803-05; Cliopatria's outline for 1815 is used

1878.2828665: Lagos Colony, 1862-1906: drawn far inland over the Yoruba states, which were independent until the 1890s; Cliopatria's outline is used
